author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Rejected drawing lost the flask (a flat hat shape with a stubby neck) and the flame read as a water drop; redrawn as a Lucide flask-conical: lip, tall neck, straight conical walls, liquid line, with a pointed flame whose notched base carries the reference's inner tongue. Checked 48px light/dark.
omissions: Rounded bottom corners made sharp (Lucide style); flame narrower than the reference to keep 8 units above the lip.
